svg.text: Motion sensor wiring: WT901C-232 → MAX3232 → UNO R4 WiFi
All four sensor wires, so the page can also set the sensor up. Motor wiring stays as it is. Switch the motor power off while you wire.
Mount it flat on the seat frame.
Any direction - you set the mounting
Arduino UNO R4 WiFi, top view
Check it is the RS-232 kind: power the sensor alone and measure yellow to black.
Negative (about −5 to −9 V) = RS-232: it needs the MAX3232, as drawn.
Never put yellow or green straight on D0 / D1 - RS-232 levels damage the board.
Modules print their pins differently: go by the names, not by this picture's order.
The page finds nothing? Swap the yellow and green wires at the DB9 (pins 2 and 3).
D0 / D1 aren't the USB port on the R4: SimHub and uploading carry on as before.
Module with pins instead of a DB9 socket: yellow → its RS-232 RX (R1IN), green → its
5V already feeds your IBT-2 boards? Put the two new red wires on that same splice.
Then in the page: Settings, Motion sensor - tick Use the sensor, press Set up the sensor, then run Seat setup.
